items.q: Harry Goodman -- insisted on buying me a drink downstairs.

ctx.x: Harry, Harry Goodman -- insisted on buying me a drink downstairs. Well, that caused a little disruption in THE attitudes there. Then a fellow from Belgium came over to see Bill Coleman, and I was working with the Golden Gate Quartet, and he was buying Bill a drink downstairs. This is no-no land. The bartenders can get fired if they serve us.

So we always had our own bottles upstairs anyhow, playing cards and, you know, take -- you know, you could relax, but it was still four flights upstairs, walking, uncomfortable quarters.
